figures.caption: Figure 1: Comparison of Legal Annotation Paradigms (Inference Time). (a) Parametric Fine-tuning (BERT): Requires updating model weights, data-hungry, rigid. (b) Generative Zero-shot (GPT-5.2): Context window limited, expensive, slow. (c) Proposed Retrieval Model (Qwen-3 Embedding): Retrieval-based, plug-and-play, handles a large and evolving set of labels efficiently.
Figure 3: Performance scaling of Legal-BERT vs. Qwen Retrieval Models across varying training sample sizes.

Figure 2: Training Phase Comparison. (Left) BERT updates all parameters 𝜃 via gradient descent. (Right) The Retrieval Model keeps the encoder frozen and selects 𝑘 on the validation set (no gradient updates).
Table 3 Main performance comparison (Micro-F1 / Macro-F1). Best results bolded.
